about: Column map from the published FOCUS 1.0 sample file (focus_sample.csv in this folder) to the columns of scripts/focus_export.py. ProviderName is read into ServiceProviderName. PublisherName holds the legal entity that sold or produced the service (for example Amazon Web Services Canada, Inc., or Red Hat Inc. for a marketplace service on AWS), which is not the host of the infrastructure, so the map keeps it as x_PublisherName and leaves HostProviderName empty: the file has no host provider column. The sample writes an empty value as the text NULL; the map turns it into an empty cell. Id is kept as x_Id so a converted row points back to its row in the published file. Check before use: FOCUS spec version.
